description: Accessible Parking Pay & Display FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. Accessible Parking Spaces/Parking Bays within Fingal County Council Pay and Display Sections. This dataset outlines the Accessible Parking Spaces/Bays within the Fingal County Council Administrative Area within our managed Pay and Display Parking Service Areas with APOCA. See disclaimer below in relation to data. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are 25 Inch Mapping, AFC-AMN-252, Accessibility, Accessible, Accessible Parking. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
